name: Improved Favored Class
body:
You are a master for your class of choice.

Benefit: You gain two benefits of your favored class bonus each time you take a level in that class. For example, if you chose to gain +1 hit point per level in your favored class, you may now gain +1 hit point and +1 skill point per level with your favored class. The benefits of this feat are retroactive if you already have levels in your favored class.
